description: The Surge conditioner: a shelving equalizer, a stereo width and balance stage, and a limiter, for putting on the end of a chain.

params.text: Sets the gain of a low shelf, -12dB to 12dB.
Sets the gain of a high shelf, -12dB to 12dB.
Sets the balance between the channels, -100% fully left and 100% fully right.
Sets the level above which the limiter pulls the signal down, -48dB to 0dB.
Sets how quickly the limiter reacts once the signal passes the threshold, -100% to 100%.
Sets how quickly the limiter lets go once the signal falls back, -100% to 100%.
Sets the output level after the limiter, -48dB to 0dB.
Nothing in the module reads this knob; the conditioner has eight parameters and the panel carries twelve knobs.
Scales both inputs before the effect processes them, from silence to unity gain.
Scales both outputs after the effect, from silence to unity gain.

inputs.text: The left input into the effect; with the right input unpatched this one feeds both channels.
The right input into the effect.
Adds to the Bass knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Treble knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Width knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Balance knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Threshold knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Attack Rate knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Release Rate knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Gain knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the conditioner has eight parameters and the panel carries twelve CV jacks.
Nothing in the module reads this jack; no parameter of the conditioner can be tempo-synced.

outputs.text: The left output of the effect; with the right output unpatched this one carries an even mix of the two channels.
The right output of the effect.

notes: the effect runs in blocks of 32 samples, so it delays the signal by 32 samples and reads its CV inputs once per block.
this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
